name: Rob Parkin
story: A caption in Landlink, Issue 8 (May 1999), names Rob Parkin as a member of the back row in a team photograph accompanying “LINZ first in mapping”. The article says the pictured team received plaques for contributions to establishing the New Zealand Topographic Digital Database and dates the four-year project to 1995 with LINZ’s predecessor DOSLI.
